boundaries: Only supported Ability prefixes and exact once-per-turn activation text are shared; prior supported programs unchanged.
Source-relative attachment and discard explicitly use SELF, including when the source is Benched.
Deck searches allow failure-to-find; hand and discard attachment use Basic physical card identity and manual-action minimum.
Each source has an independent once-per-turn use; switching does not reset usage, and suppression blocks activation.
Self shuffle returns the evolution stack, Tools and Energy without taking prizes; Active departure requires replacement.
No attack damage, attack timing, unknown conditions or old Poke-Power/Body semantics are inferred.
